n8n_license_analysis.conclusion: n8n is source-available fair-code, not OSI-approved open source. Non-.ee source is under the Sustainable Use License 1.0; .ee files require the n8n Enterprise License.
n8n_license_analysis.sustainable_use_summary: Use or modify only for your own internal business purposes or for non-commercial/personal use. Distribution is allowed only free of charge for non-commercial purposes. Do not remove licensing notices.

agency_client_workflows.allowed_condition: Building and running workflows for clients on the operator's own n8n instance is permitted only while clients cannot create or edit workflows and do not access the n8n instance or workflow logic.
agency_client_workflows.not_allowed: Hosting n8n as a service that lets clients build workflows; letting external end users build/configure workflows through a custom UI, API, MCP, or AI agent; white-labeling; using enterprise features without an Enterprise license.
agency_client_workflows.multi_client_nuance: Official FAQ says to contact license@n8n.io for managing n8n across multiple client environments; a partner program for multi-instance management is in development.

architecture_reuse_analysis.existing_control_plane: Cloudflare Worker + D1 and the Hermes control plane remain authoritative for ingress, auth, policy, state, provenance, approvals, and scheduling.
architecture_reuse_analysis.decision: Do not replace the Cloudflare/Hermes control plane. n8n is at most an optional self-hosted workflow execution adapter behind it.
recommended_reuse: Use n8n only for connector-heavy or human-in-the-loop workflows that are triggered by the existing Worker/Hermes layer via a narrow authenticated webhook.
Keep all policy, identity, approval, and persistence decisions in the existing control plane; n8n returns results/callbacks rather than owning state.
Run n8n as an internal tool on an operator-controlled instance; do not expose the n8n editor to clients or end users.
Pin the n8n image/version and keep .ee features disabled unless an Enterprise license is obtained.
If multi-client isolation is required, do not assume the community license covers multi-instance management; contact license@n8n.io first.
architecture_reuse_analysis.resource_directories: The five awesome-* repositories are curated lists, not runnable software. Use them only as research/link catalogs; do not add them as runtime dependencies or copy content without checking each declared license.
architecture_reuse_analysis.not_found_items: ai-money-mindset and ai-goods-monitor have no verified repository identity; do not build integrations against similarly named unrelated repositories.
